description: This file is an HTML document implementing the front-end interface for a database visualizer. It includes styles and scripts for displaying databases, tables, and table data, with interactive elements such as refresh buttons, expandable cells, and dynamic content loading.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the database list and resets the interface.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, handling special cases like large or object data.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data.
